modmenu.summaryTranslation.villagepax: Colonies, peoples, diplomacy and faith on one settlement engine.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.villagepa: A player colony in the spirit of MineColonies and living villages of seven peoples in the spirit of Millénaire: block-by-block building, crafts, trade and coin, quests, diplomacy and war, gods and miracles, families and generations.
villagepax.found.too_close: Too close to "%s". Find a spot further away.
villagepax.found.already_owner: You already run the colony "%s". One per player.
villagepax.found.bad_ground: The town hall needs solid ground and free space here.
villagepax.town_hall.destroyed: Town hall destroyed. The colony "%s" survives, but rebuild it.
villagepax.blueprint.hint: Place on free land to found a colony
villagepax.citizen.hungry: %s is starving: no food in storage. One more day and they leave.
villagepax.citizen.left: %s has left the colony: nobody stays to starve.
villagepax.screen.overview.days_none: No food — citizens will start leaving
villagepax.screen.buildings.none: No buildings yet. Start with a house.
villagepax.screen.buildings.order_hint: Goes where you stand, facing you
villagepax.screen.stock.hint: Shift+right-click the town hall to open its chest
villagepax.hologram.keys: %s to rotate, %s up and down, %s farther and closer
villagepax.hologram.overlaps: A building is already marked here
villagepax.hologram.keys_more: %s to pin, %s to place, %s to cancel
villagepax.screen.upgrade.top_level: %s is already at the top level
villagepax.screen.upgrade.no_room: %s has no room to grow: a neighbouring building is in the way
villagepax.citizen.label: %s — %s
villagepax.quest.nothing_left: There is nothing left to ask. To us you are %s.
villagepax.quest.not_yet: So far you are only %s to us. Come back later.
villagepax.quest.done: Now that is work. Take this, and do not forget us.
villagepax.quest.founding_1: Winter is close and the woodpiles are empty. Bring logs and I will remember it.
villagepax.quest.founding_2: There is nothing to lay the new house's footing with. We need stone.
villagepax.quest.founding_3: You are no stranger to us. Feed the village, and I will hand you a town hall blueprint: found your own settlement.
villagepax.quest.screen.nothing: Nothing more to ask. Come again.
villagepax.quest.too_far: Too far away to hand it in
villagepax.trade.screen.prices: Prices follow trust: a friend buys cheaper and sells dearer.
villagepax.trade.reason.no_trust: They do not trust you that far yet. Take up the elder's errands.
villagepax.trade.reason.village_cant: The village has neither the goods nor the coin for it. Come back later.
villagepax.trade.reason.player_cant: You have nothing to pay with.
villagepax.trade.not_here: Someone else keeps the stall here — look for the merchant
villagepax.trade.gone: That is no longer traded here
villagepax.trade.refused.no_deal: That is no longer traded here
villagepax.trade.refused.no_trust: They do not trust you that far yet
villagepax.trade.refused.no_stock: The village has none of that
villagepax.trade.refused.no_goods: You have nothing to pay with
villagepax.trade.refused.no_room: Nowhere to put it: free your hands
villagepax.tooltip.marker.why: Placed inside a building blueprint. The builder removes it while building and remembers the spot: a bed, a chest, a door or a workstation goes here.
villagepax.tooltip.marker.hint: Only needed to author your own schematic with a structure block. A finished village has no markers left.
villagepax.greeting.title: Village Pax: Norman villages stand somewhere in the forests.
villagepax.greeting.how: Find their elder and do what he asks — he will hand you a town hall blueprint, and your own colony starts from it.
villagepax.command.no_colony: You have no colony. Place a town hall with a blueprint.
villagepax.command.build.placed: Construction marked: %s level %s, footprint %s, %s blocks. It needs a citizen with the %s craft.
villagepax.command.build.bad_name: A schematic name must end with _lvl<number>: %s
villagepax.command.build.outside: This is not your land: %s is outside the bounds of %s
villagepax.command.build.locked: This building needs the rank "%s" first: %s
villagepax.command.build.overlaps: The footprint overlaps the already marked %s at %s
villagepax.command.supply.no_storage: Nowhere to put it: the colony has no storage. The town hall is the first one — place it with a blueprint.
villagepax.command.supply.full: Delivered %s of %s items across %s kinds — there is no more room
villagepax.command.hire.no_room: No room: the rank "%s" holds %s citizens, and there are already %s
villagepax.command.sites.no_place: no site in this cell (biome or height)
villagepax.command.status.colony: Colony %s: %s citizens, %s buildings, %s storages, %s items in stock
villagepax.command.config.reloaded: Settings reloaded: peoples' villages %s, population ×%s, hunger %s/%s days. File: %s
villagepax.locate.none: No village sites nearby: peoples settle in biomes %s, and none is around.
villagepax.locate.found: Nearest village: %s, around %s, %s blocks from here.
villagepax.quest.maya_founding_1: The temple thatch has worn through and we have no jungle logs left: they all went into the retaining wall. Bring some and I will remember it.
villagepax.quest.maya_founding_2: The terrace is slipping after the rains. We need stone, a lot of it, or the field will go down with the harvest.
villagepax.quest.maya_founding_3: You are no stranger to us. Feed the village, and I will hand you a town hall blueprint: found your own settlement.
villagepax.purse.how: Use to stow coins, sneak-use to shake them out. g/s/c — gold, silver, copper.
villagepax.purse.nothing_to_add: Nothing to stow: not a coin on you
villagepax.build.stuck: Construction halted: %s is waiting for %s — %s short
villagepax.caravan.arrived: A caravan from %s has arrived — %s. It leaves tomorrow.
villagepax.caravan.homeless: The village that sent the caravan is gone
villagepax.people.screen.about: Word travels through the whole people: a favour to one village lifts trust in the others, and lowers it among those who dislike them.
villagepax.gift.reason.empty_handed: Hold the gift in your hand.
villagepax.gift.reason.not_wanted: They have no use for this. Look at what the village buys.
villagepax.gift.reason.too_little: Too little even for a polite nod.
villagepax.gift.reason.already_today: You gave already today. Come back tomorrow.
villagepax.raid.coming: A war band left "%s": %s under arms. They will be here by morning. You can still reach their elder and pay them off.
villagepax.raid.here: A war band stands at the gates of "%s". Defend your people.
villagepax.raid.repelled: The raid on "%s" is beaten off: none of them are left.
villagepax.raid.left: The war band has withdrawn from "%s" — the grudge has not.
villagepax.citizen.murder_costs: "%s" will not forget this: trust down by %s.
villagepax.raid.wrecked: The war band wrecked your %s. The builder will mend it — if there is stock.
villagepax.greeting.where: Nearest are the %s: around %s, some %s blocks away.
villagepax.greeting.nowhere: No villages nearby: each people settles in its own biomes. Travel on and ask again: /villagepax locate
villagepax.greeting.book_hover: A book with what you need in the first hour
villagepax.guide.given: The wayfarer's notes are in your hands.
villagepax.guide.what:
Village Pax

Somewhere stand villages not your own: their houses, their fields, their trade.

You have nothing yet — but the right to come and speak.
villagepax.guide.find:
Find a village

It may stand hundreds of blocks away, and only in its own biome.

Ask the way:
/villagepax locate
villagepax.guide.elder:
The elder

Click him. He will name an errand: logs, stone, food.

Bring it and click again. Trust is shown in the same window.
villagepax.guide.blueprint:
The blueprint

The third errand hands you the town hall blueprint.

Place it on level solid ground and the colony is yours — with its first citizen, a builder.
villagepax.guide.console:
The colony console

Click your town hall.

Citizens, food, beds and building are there, and there you hand out crafts: builder, courier, farmer, lumberjack, guard.
villagepax.guide.order:
Marking a building

Stand where you want it and press "Mark".

It will face you. A ghost shows the footprint before the first block.
villagepax.guide.storage:
Storage

Put what the building needs into the town hall chest.

The courier carries, the builder lays. If something is missing, the chat says what.
villagepax.guide.citizens:
Citizens

A new one arrives when there is a free bed and food in storage.

A hungry colony empties: first a warning, then they leave.
villagepax.guide.trade:
Trade

The elder keeps a stall.

The coin is our own: copper, silver, gold — nine to one. A purse carries them for you.
villagepax.guide.trust:
Trust

A friend buys cheaper and sells dearer.

It grows with errands, trade and gifts. Give what the village buys, and no more than once a day.
villagepax.guide.people:
The people

Word travels past one village: a favour to one reaches the whole people — and their rivals the other way.

See the "People" tab.
villagepax.guide.caravan:
Caravans

A village that counts you a friend sends a merchant with a cart.

He stands a day by your hall. You may rob him — but everyone will know.
villagepax.guide.raid:
The sword

A killed villager and a robbed caravan cost trust.

Let it fall too low and they will come armed. You get a day's warning. Hand someone the guard's craft before that.
villagepax.guide.peace:
Peace

You can cut down those who come, but it does not make peace.

Only what broke it can mend it: gifts and deeds.
villagepax.found.next: Click the town hall: crafts and building are there. Mark a house first — nobody moves into an empty field.
villagepax.screen.order.needs_none: The stock is already there — the builder will start on his own.
villagepax.screen.overview.idle_hint: The Buildings tab: pick what to raise, then stand where you want it.
villagepax.screen.overview.deserted: Nobody is left in the colony. Put food in the town hall chest — a settler will come by morning.
villagepax.build.no_builder: Building has stalled: the colony has no builder. Hand someone that craft in the town hall console.
villagepax.advice.deserted: Nobody is left. Put food in the town hall chest — a settler comes by morning.
villagepax.advice.no_storage: Nowhere to store: place a chest by the hall, or finish the warehouse.
villagepax.advice.no_food: No food. Bring bread or carrots to the town hall chest, or your people will leave.
villagepax.advice.no_builder: Nobody can build. Hand someone the builder's craft on the Citizens tab.
villagepax.advice.no_beds: Every bed is taken. Mark another house — nobody comes without a free bed.
villagepax.advice.no_farm: You are the food supply. Mark a farm and hand someone the farmer's craft.
villagepax.advice.nothing_building: Nothing is being built. Open the Buildings tab and mark what to raise next.
villagepax.people.screen.war_threat: Their patience is spent: next time %s will come with swords.
villagepax.people.screen.truce_about: They will not march for now, but nothing is forgiven. Make amends while it lasts.
villagepax.peace.bought: %s take the payment: %s. No raids for %s days — but no trust is returned.
villagepax.peace.reason.not_at_war: These people are not at war with you.
villagepax.peace.reason.no_coin: You are not carrying that much coin.
villagepax.peace.reason.no_room: The village has nowhere to put the payment.
villagepax.raid.mourning: %s are burying their dead: %s quiet days.
villagepax.raid.bought_off: The band leaves %s: peace is paid for.
villagepax.advice.under_siege: A war band is at the gates. Defend your people — or reach their elder and pay them off while you still can.
villagepax.level.reached: The colony %s has grown: it is now a %s!
villagepax.screen.growth.how: Raise the town hall to level %s to unlock:
villagepax.screen.growth.top: Nothing higher: the colony is at its greatest rank.
villagepax.screen.growth.nothing: Nothing new — but borders and room for people grow.
villagepax.screen.assign.locked: That craft unlocks when the colony grows.
villagepax.screen.place.locked: This building needs the colony to be at least: %s
villagepax.hologram.locked: Too early: the colony has not grown into it
villagepax.town_hall.not_yours: %s is someone else's colony. Its console and storage are open to its owner and those they trust.
villagepax.screen.order.no_colony: Found a colony first: place a town hall with the blueprint and its console will hold the build list.
villagepax.screen.order.too_far: Too far away: step closer to the building site.
villagepax.screen.console.not_yours: Not your console: you can only command your own colony.
villagepax.tribute.taken: %s now pays tribute for %s days. Your alliance with them is broken.
villagepax.tribute.reason.no_town: Build a town first: you have nothing to demand with.
villagepax.tribute.reason.not_beaten: Beat their war band first — and come while they remember.
villagepax.tribute.reason.too_friendly: You do not take tribute from friends.
villagepax.people.screen.levy_about: A beaten village pays you in silver. Every payment breeds resentment.
villagepax.people.screen.pact_about: An allied village sends fighters when raiders come for your colony.
villagepax.people.screen.pact_done: Allied: they will come to help.
villagepax.pact.forged: %s: alliance forged for %s. Trouble comes — so do they.
villagepax.pact.reason.already: You are already allied with this village.
villagepax.pact.reason.not_friends: Become friends first: alliances are forged with friends.
villagepax.pact.reason.no_town: Build a town first: a hamlet has nothing to offer.
villagepax.pact.reason.no_coin: You need a gold coin on you.
villagepax.pact.reason.no_room: The village has nowhere to put the gift.
villagepax.trade.at_the_stall: The merchant at the stall handles trade — I speak of other matters.
villagepax.screen.growth.not_yet: No town hall of that level exists yet — this rank is still ahead.
villagepax.faith.altar.nowhere: This altar belongs to no one: there is no settlement here.
villagepax.faith.altar.head: Altar of %s. Those who listen here:
villagepax.faith.offering.no_pantheon: This people prays to no one: they have no gods.
villagepax.faith.offering.not_theirs: The gods here take no such thing: %s means nothing to them.
villagepax.faith.offering.already_today: %s accepts one offering a day. Come back tomorrow.
villagepax.faith.offering.not_yours: This is the altar of %s. Everyone speaks to their own sky — build a temple of your own.
villagepax.faith.blessing.no_god: This people has no god of that (%s).
villagepax.faith.blessing.not_noticed: The god (%s) has not noticed the colony yet. Bring offerings.
villagepax.faith.blessing.always_on: The chosen are blessed for free: it already holds (%s).
villagepax.faith.miracle.done: The miracle (%s) is done. %s favour spent.
villagepax.faith.miracle.no_god: This people has no god of that (%s).
villagepax.faith.miracle.not_heard: The god (%s) has not heard the colony yet: miracles need the Heard tier.
villagepax.faith.miracle.nothing_to_do: Nothing to ask for: %s is already as it should be.
villagepax.artifact.not_here: The artifact has nothing to do here: this is not your land.
villagepax.artifact.plumb: The plumb set the work straight: %s.
villagepax.artifact.plumb_idle: Nothing to build: every building is finished.
villagepax.artifact.tooltip.harvest: Use on a plot — the whole field grows.
villagepax.artifact.tooltip.stone: Use on a building site — the work leaps ahead.
villagepax.artifact.tooltip.gift: A god's gift. It cannot be mined or crafted.
villagepax.screen.faith.no_pantheon: This people prays to no one.
villagepax.screen.faith.needs_temple: The gods hear you without a roof, but the people need somewhere to go. Build a temple and the colony will settle.
villagepax.guide.faith:
§lFaith§r

Build a temple and an altar rises in it.

Lay on it what the gods of your people take: grain, stone, iron. What you lay is who you pray to.
villagepax.quest.lumberjack_1: I fell trees faster than the grove grows. Bring me saplings and I'll plant for us both.
villagepax.quest.lumberjack_2: The soil here is mean; an oak takes ten years. Give me bone meal and it'll stand in a week. And I'll put in a word for you with the Sower.
villagepax.quest.guard_1: They come out of the woods at night. We have bows and nothing to put on them.
villagepax.quest.guard_2: For blades. The mountain is far and our smith has no iron. Bring some and I'll give you my old shield — it saved me three times.
villagepax.quest.guard_3: Words are words, gates are gates. Raise a tower of your own and put a man on it. Do that and I'll send you my youngest — he's outgrown this place.
villagepax.quest.brewer_1: Ale without sweetness is bitter water. Cane grows by the river, and the river is a day away.
villagepax.quest.brewer_2: I can brew it; I've nothing to pour it into. Bring bottles — the first four are yours.
villagepax.quest.brewer_3: The craft is in the hands, not the barrel. Set up a cauldron of your own and I'll send an apprentice to finish his learning on your barley.
villagepax.quest.maya_weaver_1: The spider spins better than I do, and asks less. Bring me thread and I'll weave you cloth.
villagepax.quest.maya_weaver_2: White wool takes dye the way lime takes ochre. Three bolts will be yours.
villagepax.quest.maya_weaver_3: Have a loom and you'll have a weaver. Raise a weavery and I'll let my sister go — she spins straighter than I do and has nothing here for her hands.
villagepax.quest.maya_farmer_1: Cacao grows in shade, and we cut our shade for terraces. Bring beans and I'll plant again.
villagepax.quest.maya_farmer_2: The upper terrace has been drying for three years. Give me meal and I'll ask the Rain-Giver for us both.
villagepax.quest.maya_guard_1: A shaft without a feather flies where it likes. We're short of feathers — the birds left with the trees.
villagepax.quest.maya_guard_2: The gold is not for show. The Night Jaguar is given gold and sleeps easy — and an easy jaguar is an easy night.
villagepax.quest.maya_guard_3: Show me you can keep your own. Have a tower and I'll send a man — he sees in the dark better than I do.
villagepax.quest.founding_4: You have a hall and no timber. Raise a lumberjack's hut: without your own wood, winter will outlast you.
villagepax.quest.founding_5: A people that prays to no one we do not count as neighbours. Raise a temple and speak to the sky — and we will speak to you differently.
villagepax.quest.founding_6: Go to the Maya. We've been wary of them three generations and neither of us remembers why. A living man is worth more than rumour — come back and I'll let our weaver go with you.
villagepax.quest.maya_founding_4: The hall stands — and what will you eat? Break a field. Stone does not feed; earth does.
villagepax.quest.maya_founding_5: Your walls stand on someone else's earth, and the earth knows it. Lay stone on the altar and ask the Sky-Holder — then the walls will be yours.
villagepax.quest.maya_founding_6: In the north live people in white walls. They say we are savages; we say the same of them. Go and see for yourself — and when you return, take our farmer with you.
villagepax.quest.needs_colony: This is not for a man without a roof. Found your own settlement, then we'll talk.
villagepax.errand.elder: The village needs this. A small thing we can't gather ourselves.
villagepax.errand.lumberjack: My hands are on the axe. Lend me yours?
villagepax.errand.farmer: The field has its own needs, and they don't wait for autumn.
villagepax.errand.brewer: The cauldron is boiling and I'm short of something.
villagepax.errand.weaver: The loom stands idle, and that's worse than it sounds.
villagepax.errand.guard: The watch needs this. I'm not asking for myself.
villagepax.errand.builder: The work has stopped. We're short of the plainest thing.
villagepax.errand.courier: The road is long and I've nothing to set out with.
villagepax.guide.errands:
§lErrands§r

The elder has a chain of her own; so do the woodsman, guard, brewer and weaver.

Each asks by their own trade. Chain done, a day's errand remains.
villagepax.advice.idle_hands: People sit idle while workplaces stand empty. Hand out crafts in the Citizens tab.
villagepax.advice.no_neighbours: You know no one. Find a village (/villagepax locate) and speak to its elder: they have errands, goods and blueprints.
villagepax.advice.no_temple: Your people have nowhere to go and you have no one to speak to. Raise a temple.
villagepax.advice.no_faith: The temple stands empty. Lay on the altar what the local gods take, and they will notice you.
villagepax.advice.raise_the_hall: All is running well. Raise the town hall: the next tier opens what the colony has never had.
villagepax.life.grown_up: %s has grown up and taken to work.
villagepax.life.died: %s died of old age. Days lived: %s.
villagepax.screen.assign.too_young: This is a child. They will take up a trade when they grow.
villagepax.guide.life:
§lAge§r

Citizens age, but only on the days your colony lived before your eyes.

Away in a mine for a month and nobody grew older.

The old work at half and one day die.
villagepax.screen.assign.wrong_nature: %s will not take a sword — that is who they are. Give the craft to someone else.
villagepax.nature.even.what: An ordinary person: no faster and no slower than the rest.
villagepax.nature.lazy.what: Works at half strength — but endures twice as long and is the last to leave.
villagepax.nature.ambitious.what: Age is no hindrance: works at full strength even as an elder. Leaves twice as fast when unhappy.
villagepax.nature.pious.what: While the colony has an altar, carries one thing to it a day — faith grows without you.
villagepax.nature.coward.what: Will not take a sword, and flees a raider sooner and further than anyone.
villagepax.conquest.taken: Your colony has been taken: %s left without losing a single fighter. Tribute for %s days.
villagepax.conquest.took: The village of %s is taken: your war band came back whole. Tribute for %s days.
villagepax.conquest.freed: The yoke is thrown off: the war band from %s fell at your gates. The tribute ends.
villagepax.yoke.unpaid: Nothing to pay the tribute with, and %s remembers it. The treasury is empty.
villagepax.yoke.over: The tribute has run its term: %s expects nothing more.
villagepax.campaign.set_out: The war band sets out: %s swords against %s. Two days' march (%s).
villagepax.campaign.home_whole: The war band is back from %s whole: %s swords, no losses.
villagepax.campaign.home_bloodied: The war band is back from %s: %s swords, %s did not return.
villagepax.campaign.not_a_neighbour: You do not march on your own.
villagepax.campaign.no_town: Towns wage war, hamlets do not. Raise the town hall.
villagepax.campaign.no_guards: Nobody to send: a war band needs at least two guards.
villagepax.campaign.already: Your war band is already out. There is no second one.
villagepax.campaign.busy: Someone is already at that village's gates.
villagepax.campaign.besieged: There is a war band at your own gates. Deal with that first.
villagepax.campaign.too_far: Too far: the war band would never get there.
villagepax.people.screen.march_about: Or march on them: %s swords leave, and none stay behind to guard.
villagepax.screen.overview.yoke_line: The colony pays tribute to %s. Days left: %s. Beat off their next war band and it ends.
villagepax.advice.under_yoke: The colony is under tribute: silver leaves every morning. Beat off their next war band and the yoke falls.
villagepax.campaign.too_friendly: This is a friend. Friendship and war are different conversations.
villagepax.quest.pony_founding_1: We are short of rails: the herd has grown and the paddock has not. Bring spruce and we will fence it.
villagepax.quest.pony_founding_2: Winter comes and there will not be hay enough. Bring bales, and I will remember who helped.
villagepax.quest.pony_founding_3: You are no stranger now. Feed the village, and I will give you the moot hall's plan: raise your own.
villagepax.quest.pony_founding_4: Walls stand — but what will you eat? Break a paddock. Rails do not feed you; grass does.
villagepax.quest.pony_founding_5: The land does not bear on its own. Lay what you grew before the Green Mother, and she will remember you in spring.
villagepax.quest.pony_founding_6: Beyond the river live those who build in stone and look down on us. Go and speak kindly. Come back, and you take our ploughman with you.
villagepax.quest.pony_herder_1: The grain went to seed and the horses eat today. Bring wheat and I will pay in coin.
villagepax.quest.pony_herder_2: A lead breaks where the hide is thin. Bring me thick leather and I will braid one that holds a stallion.
villagepax.quest.pony_watcher_1: The flint is gone, and without it there is neither fire nor arrowhead. Bring some and I will knap it.
villagepax.quest.pony_watcher_2: Raise a lookout and watch for yourself. Raise it, and I will send you one of mine: from the saddle he sees further than you do from a roof.
villagepax.wages.unpaid: The treasury is empty: %s went unpaid. They will work at half strength from tomorrow.
villagepax.screen.tax.no_village: Money starts with the village. A hamlet has none, and nobody to take it from.
villagepax.advice.empty_purse: The treasury is empty and wages fall due tomorrow. Sell something to the neighbours — or take people off their crafts.
villagepax.advice.coin_leaks: Coin is leaving the colony: your people have nobody to spend it with. Raise a stall and give someone the merchant's craft.
villagepax.screen.citizens.foes_hint: While they share a craft, both lose content every day. Move one to another workshop and the quarrel ends.
villagepax.citizenship.not_a_village: You are the master here already.
villagepax.citizenship.not_a_friend: Houses go to their own. Work for the village and the answer will differ.
villagepax.citizenship.no_room: No house stands empty. Come back when one does.
villagepax.citizenship.already: You already have a house here.
villagepax.citizenship.granted: %s has given you a house. The bed and the chest are yours, and there will be food every morning.
villagepax.citizenship.evicted: %s has taken your house back: you are no longer counted one of theirs.
villagepax.people.screen.home_about: Or ask to live here: the village gives a house — a bed, a chest and a ration.
villagepax.found.needs_mountain: Dwarves do not settle under open sky: a hold needs stone overhead, not grass. Find a mountain and set the hall inside it.
villagepax.quest.dwarf_founding_1: The mountain has everything but timber. Bring logs — we have nothing to shore the vaults with.
villagepax.quest.dwarf_founding_2: Grain will not grow for us: roots grow under stone, ears do not. Bring wheat and we will have something to wash it down with.
villagepax.quest.dwarf_founding_3: You have been about for days now. Feed the hold and I will hand you the plan of a hall: cut your own, since you have learned to walk in the dark.
villagepax.quest.dwarf_founding_4: You have vaults and no light. Bring torches: a dark hold belongs to someone other than the one who cut it.
villagepax.quest.dwarf_founding_5: A pick dulls faster than stone grows. Bring iron and we will reforge.
villagepax.quest.dwarf_founding_6: The last one. We neither wear gold nor hoard it — we pay the Stonefather with it. Bring some and you leave here with our stonecutter.
villagepax.quest.dwarf_delver_1: It is dark at the gate, and the dark has tenants. Bring lanterns — I will hang them so there is not one shadow from the doors to the hall.
villagepax.quest.dwarf_delver_2: Grates rust, and we have only the one way in. Bring iron and I will reforge all eight.
villagepax.quest.dwarf_brewer_1: Mushrooms grow by themselves here, only not where I can walk to them. Bring some and I will set them fermenting.
villagepax.quest.dwarf_brewer_2: Brew on root is stronger than brew on mushroom. Bring carrots — and the first cup is yours, before the elder ever tastes it.
villagepax.found.needs_forest: Elves do not settle on the ground: the bower goes up in the canopy, on a trunk. Climb into the forest and build there.
villagepax.quest.elf_founding_1: A forest is not forever if it is only taken from. Bring saplings — we will plant them where others felled.
villagepax.quest.elf_founding_2: We do not break stone, but you cannot set a hearth on planks. Bring cobblestone and we will finally have somewhere to light a fire without burning the platform down.
villagepax.quest.elf_founding_3: You walk our bridges like one of us. Feed the bower and I will hand you the plan: raise your own, since you have learned to walk up here.
villagepax.quest.elf_founding_4: Bridges hold on the ropes beneath, not on the planks. Bring string — we will re-tie them while they still hold.
villagepax.quest.elf_founding_5: The bees have left the lower tier, and without them there will be neither apples nor saplings. Bring honeycomb and we will lure them back.
villagepax.quest.elf_founding_6: The last one, and an unpleasant one. Iron does not grow here and axes dull. Bring some and you leave with our carver.
villagepax.quest.elf_watcher_1: From the platform you can see far, but there is nothing to shoot with. Bring feathers and I will fletch.
villagepax.quest.elf_watcher_2: The flint for arrowheads is gone. Bring some and I will stop counting arrows one by one.
villagepax.quest.elf_weaver_1: We take thread from underfoot, but the spiders are careful this year. Bring some and I will weave while my hands remember how.
villagepax.quest.elf_weaver_2: We do not spin wool — there is nothing here to shear. Bring some and I will dye it the colour of the canopy, and you will have a cloak the forest does not see.
villagepax.guide.homes:
§lWhere folk live§r

Normans, Maya and ponies live on the ground.

Dwarves live in the mountain: set the hall into stone, not grass. Elves live in the canopy, on a trunk.

Set it wrong and you are told why.
villagepax.guide.wages:
§lWages§r

Each citizen is paid a copper a day from the treasury: the coin in your store.

Unpaid, they work at half and then leave.

Tax and trade fill it.
villagepax.guide.guest:
§lOne of their own§r

Befriend a whole village and they give you a house.

Then you are no guest: a roof of your own and a say in what they build.

Lose their trust and it is taken back.
villagepax.guide.war:
§lThe march§r

The sword is not only theirs. Gather guards and march on a village yourself.

Win, and it is your vassal: it pays tribute and joins your wars.
villagepax.guide.faith_gifts:
§lGifts§r

A god takes one offering a day, and it lasts.

In return: a blessing for three days, a miracle on a black day, and at "Warded" a gift found nowhere else.
villagepax.guide.errands_more:
§lWhat it pays§r

An errand pays coin and a grain of trust. Every day.

They ask for more than goods: raise the same workshop, pray at an altar, walk to the neighbours. And they pay with a person.
villagepax.guide.kin:
§lKin§r

Two grown and unwed find each other. A pair has a child if there is a bed and room under the cap.

A child eats and sleeps but does not work, for eight days.

Death is switched off in settings.
villagepax.guide.bonds:
§lBonds and nature§r

Citizens make friends and enemies on their own. Beside a friend they work better.

And each has a nature: even, hot, tireless, timid, kind. Given at birth, never changed.
villagepax.config.title: Village Pax Settings
villagepax.config.adjusted: Disagrees with other settings — %s will be saved.
villagepax.config.remote: You are on someone else’s server: its own settings apply there. Changes go to your file and work in your worlds.
villagepax.config.autonomous_villages.to: Whether villages of the peoples appear in the world and whether standing ones live on. Turn off if you only want your own colony.
villagepax.config.village_spacing_chunks: How far apart villages rise. 0 means as their people intend. Only affects land where no village has risen yet.
villagepax.config.population_scale.toolt: How many times more or fewer people fit in a settlement of each level.
villagepax.config.ticks_per_decision.too: How often a citizen decides what to do next. Lower is livelier but heavier on the server.
villagepax.config.carry_slots.tooltip: How many different things a citizen carries from the warehouse in one trip.
villagepax.config.hunger_warn_days.toolt: How many days without food a citizen bears in silence before complaining.
villagepax.config.hunger_leave_days.tool: After how many hungry days a citizen leaves for good. Always later than the complaint.
villagepax.config.child_days.tooltip: How many game days a citizen stays a child: eats and sleeps but does not work.
villagepax.config.life_days.tooltip: How many game days a citizen lives. Old age is the last third.
villagepax.config.mortality.tooltip: Whether citizens die of old age. Turn off and the colony lives forever, but stops renewing itself.
How much material a caravan brings a village per game day, paid with the village’s own coin.
villagepax.config.village_income_per_day: How much coin a village earns per day from its fields and crafts.
villagepax.config.road_reserve.tooltip: How much cobblestone and gravel is never spent on streets: until the reserve is full, stone waits for walls.
villagepax.config.citizen_labels.tooltip: Show a citizen’s name and craft above their head.
villagepax.config.building_labels.toolti: Show names above the buildings of the colony.
villagepax.config.greet_newcomers.toolti: Tell a player who joins without a colony where to begin.
villagepax.config.structure_distance_chu: How far a village of the peoples keeps from vanilla villages, outposts and temples so as not to grow into them. 0 means no distance at all. Only affects land where no village has risen yet.
villagepax.config.protect_colonies.toolt: Only the owner and those they trust (/villagepax trust) may break, place, open chests and strike citizens on colony land. Guests walk, open doors and talk.
villagepax.protection.denied: This is the land of the colony "%s": only its owner and those they trust build here.
villagepax.command.trust.done: %s may now build and break on the land of the colony "%s".
villagepax.command.trust.already: %s may already build on the colony land.
villagepax.command.untrust.done: %s may no longer build on the land of the colony "%s".
villagepax.command.trusted.none: Nobody is trusted in the colony "%s": only the owner builds.
villagepax.command.trusted.list: Trusted to build in the colony "%s": %s
villagepax.guide.neighbours:
§lNeighbours§r

On colony land only the owner and those they trust build. A guest walks and talks.

§o/villagepax trust§r to trust.
§o/villagepax untrust§r to take it back.
villagepax.guide.treats:
§lTreats§r

Each people has its own treat.

Pony cupcake: a rainbow and speed.
Dwarven stout: sense the ore.
Elven nectar: fall like a leaf.

A popper: a party, and citizens wave back.
villagepax.advice.thin_food: Food for a day or two. Sow a field or bring bread to the town hall chest before your people go hungry.
villagepax.quest.nord_founding_1: Our winter is longer than our summer, and firewood is always short. Bring spruce, and we will remember who warmed our hearths.
villagepax.quest.nord_founding_2: The forest is wet and the frost is dry. Without coal the forge stands still, and so do we. Bring coal.
villagepax.quest.nord_founding_3: You share our bread, so you are one of us. Bring bread for the feast, and I will give you the plan of a longhouse.
villagepax.quest.nord_founding_4: A house without a garden is a feast without food. Plant a garden: the short summer must be met with seeds in hand.
villagepax.quest.nord_founding_5: The Hearth Mother feeds those who feed her. Lay the first harvest before her, and the winter will pass us by.
villagepax.quest.nord_founding_6: Under the mountains live those who forge better than we do. Befriend the dwarves, and one of ours will come to you.
villagepax.quest.nord_fisher_1: The ice came early and the nets are empty. Bring cod, and we will last the winter.
villagepax.quest.nord_fisher_2: Leather cracks in the frost, and there is no more. Bring leather, and I will give you my rod; it fishes under the ice.
villagepax.quest.nord_watcher_1: A shield without a boss is a plank. Bring iron, and the watch will stand firm.
villagepax.quest.nord_watcher_2: Build a lookout and watch the ice yourself. Build it, and I will send one of ours: he sees a wolf a mile away.
villagepax.signpost.head: Carved on the post:
villagepax.signpost.nothing: The post is silent: no villages nearby.
villagepax.needs.head: %s: a village of the %s
villagepax.needs.nothing_building: Nothing is being built right now.
villagepax.needs.food_low: Food is nearly gone: bread, carrots and other food are welcome.
villagepax.needs.hint: Bring what is needed and click the town hall with it in hand: the village will take it and remember who helped.
villagepax.needs.not_needed: The village does not need this right now.
villagepax.needs.no_room: The village storehouse has no room for this.
villagepax.guide.help:
§lHelping a village§r

Click a village town hall to learn what it needs: what is built, what is short, how much food is left.

Click with the thing in hand: the village takes it and trusts you more.
villagepax.gear.norman.strike: Knocks the foe back and steadies the knight
villagepax.gear.pony.set: Jump Boost — hop like a pony
villagepax.gear.pony.strike: Kicks the foe into the air and fills you with rainbow
villagepax.gear.dwarf.set: Haste, and night vision under stone
villagepax.gear.dwarf.strike: Stuns the foe. Mines stone like a pickaxe
villagepax.gear.elf.strike: Marks the prey with light, and heals you at night
villagepax.gear.nord.set: Berserk strength when hurt; the cold cannot touch you
villagepax.guide.gear:
§lGear of the peoples§r

Each people has its own armor and weapon: the Nord axe, the dwarven hammer, the Yamato katana.

Villages sell them to friends, or craft them yourself. A full set grants the people's strength.
villagepax.quest.yamato_founding_1: The cherry blooms for a week, but a house stands for a century. Bring cherry logs, and we will raise a house that sees a hundred springs.
villagepax.quest.yamato_founding_2: Without paper there is no window, no lantern, no letter. Bring paper, and our houses will be full of light.
villagepax.quest.yamato_founding_3: Whoever shares our rice is one of us. Bring bread for the blossom festival, and I will give you the plan of a manor.
villagepax.quest.yamato_founding_4: Rice loves water the way we love silence. Lay out a rice paddy, and autumn will come with full granaries.
villagepax.quest.yamato_founding_5: Inari's foxes see who brings the first sheaf. Lay the first harvest before her, and the year will be well fed.
villagepax.quest.yamato_founding_6: In the bright forests live those who listen to the trees as we do. Befriend the elves, and one of ours will come to you.
villagepax.quest.yamato_rice_1: Last year's seed came up poorly. Bring fresh seed, and we will sow again while the water is warm.
villagepax.quest.yamato_rice_2: The water leaves the paddy, and we have nothing to carry it in. Bring buckets, and I will give you my hoe.
villagepax.quest.yamato_watcher_1: A good blade begins with good iron. Bring iron, and the guard will be ready.
villagepax.quest.yamato_watcher_2: Build a pagoda: from its roof you can see the whole valley. Build it, and I will send you one who never sleeps on watch.
villagepax.gear.yamato.strike: A clean cut: the foe weakens amid falling cherry petals
villagepax.charm.homeward.nowhere: No road home leads from here
item.villagepax.pilgrim_reliquary.desc: Below a third of health: a golden shield and healing. Every two minutes
item.villagepax.jade_jaguar.desc: See in the dark; swift as a jaguar at night
item.villagepax.lucky_horseshoe.desc: Luck with loot, and a rainbow trail when sprinting
item.villagepax.ore_gem.desc: Under stone you sense ore and dig faster
item.villagepax.moon_pendant.desc: Always light-footed; at night wounds close
item.villagepax.thunder_rune.desc: Lightning where you look. Once a minute
item.villagepax.homeward_charm.desc: Hold for three seconds to return to your colony's town hall
item.villagepax.magnet_charm.desc: Items and experience fly to you. Sneak to stop
item.villagepax.sea_shell.desc: Breathe and swim like a dolphin underwater
villagepax.war_drum.resting: The drum still hums — let it rest

villagepax.weathervane.storm: The vane spins: the storm passes in %s min
villagepax.weathervane.rain_ends: The vane turns to the sun: rain ends in %s min
villagepax.weathervane.rain_comes: The vane turns to the clouds: rain in %s min
villagepax.rune_stone.saga.0: "Who builds a house on snow builds it forever."
villagepax.rune_stone.saga.1: "Here stood Bjorn. The wolf left hungry."
villagepax.rune_stone.saga.2: "The mead of friendship is sweeter than the mead of victory."
villagepax.rune_stone.saga.3: "The Thunderer strikes those who laugh at the storm."
villagepax.rune_stone.saga.4: "The ice remembers everyone who walked on it."
villagepax.rune_stone.saga.5: "A long night makes a long saga."
villagepax.rune_stone.saga.6: "A guest at the hearth is a joy; a guest with a sword is business."
villagepax.rune_stone.saga.7: "Stone lies less than people: it is hard to rewrite."
villagepax.guide.wonders:
§lWonders and charms§r

The peoples have their marvels: toro, furin, rune stone, war drum, jaguar idol, weathervane, scarecrow.

Wear a charm in the off hand. A people gives its charm to friends.

villagepax.command.raise.failed: A %s village did not rise at %s: the place is taken, another village is near, or the ground is wrong.
villagepax.festival_hat.tooltip: Festival hat: the %s wave to whoever wears it

villagepax.contest.rule.chase: Three critters dash around the pen — catch them with a click before the villagers do.
villagepax.contest.rule.archery: Eight shots from the festival bow at three targets: a bullseye is 5 points, the far target triples it.

villagepax.contest.reason.besieged: A raid — no time for games

villagepax.contest.reason.too_far: Come to the fair — the entertainer calls those nearby

villagepax.contest.cancel.broken: %s broke and is off — see the server log.

villagepax.contest.hunt.not_yours: This one is for the players: the hunt started without you.
villagepax.contest.chase.not_yours: This one is for the players: the chase started without you.

villagepax.entertainer.call.0: %s is only %s days away — come along, you won't regret it!
villagepax.entertainer.call.1: Who'll come first at the %1$s? We'll know in %2$s days!
villagepax.entertainer.call.2: Balls don't fly by themselves — practising for the %s. %s days to go.
villagepax.entertainer.call.3: There are ribbons for everyone! The %s is in %s days.
villagepax.entertainer.call.4: Heard the news? There will be pies at the %s! Just %s days.
villagepax.entertainer.call.5: Come to the %s in %s days — let's play!

villagepax.entertainer.today.1: It's a holiday! Who's first? Click me and pick a game.
villagepax.entertainer.today.2: Ribbons are waiting for the winners — today is the %s!
villagepax.entertainer.today.3: Hey, don't stand aside — it's a festival today!
villagepax.festival.reason.no_host: No entertainer to host the festival
villagepax.festival.reason.besieged: A raid is on — no time for a festival
villagepax.festival.today: %s: today is the %s! Contests at the entertainer's stall on the fairground.
villagepax.festival.screen.open: Festival today — %s %s calls you to play!
villagepax.festival.screen.stall_closed: The stall opens only on the festival. Ribbons are won in the contests.
